items.note: Agent finds overcooling, bypass/recirculation and proposes sealing, blanking, tile changes, raising intake toward 80F and standby CAUs, but omits hot-aisle containment/ceiling return and does not reach the 40 kW package savings.
Agent proposes BAS calibration, CHWS reset and addressing low delta-T, but misses the >60% bypass recirculation control and the 43.6F to >=55F setpoint with its quantified savings.
Agent addresses secondary chilled-water pumps only as an analog and does not propose running both glycol secondary pumps slower or VFDs with DP control on glycol primary pumps.
Agent favors CHW-first operation and DX lockout except at peak, but does not eliminate the glycol/DX system or propose higher-temperature CHW with water-side economizer heat exchangers.
Agent proposes lighting occupancy/LED savings and UPS ECO/load-factor study, but not generator block-heater setpoint reset or >96% efficient UPS at replacement.
Agent provides no aggregate package totaling about 92 kW, 929,000 kWh/yr, $65,000/yr, 1.2-year payback, or PUE improvement from 2.26 to 1.74.
